facts.sourceSentence: **p.2 and p.4 = card BACKS** — confirmed: every slot is the "DOOM MACHINE / BY NATHAN MEUNIER" back art, EXCEPT p.2 row 1 col 3, which is the **Player HP card's B side**

facts.statement: The Player HP card's B side at p.2 r1c3 is the duplex mirror of the Player HP A side at p.1 r1c1.
facts.sourceSentence: the **Player HP card's B side** (the duplex-mirror of the Player HP A side at p.1 row 1 col 1).

facts.statement: Page 4 consists of nine identical card backs with no exceptions.
facts.sourceSentence: p.4 is nine identical backs, no exceptions.

facts.statement: The component set includes fifteen machine part cards that are not the Core.
facts.sourceSentence: - 15 machine part cards (non-Core)

facts.statement: The component set includes one Doom Core card, titled "THE DOOM CORE".
facts.sourceSentence: - 1 Doom Core card ("THE DOOM CORE")

facts.statement: The component set includes one Doom Machine tracking card.
facts.sourceSentence: - 1 Doom Machine tracking card

facts.statement: The component set includes one Player HP tracking card that is double-sided, with its A side on p.1 and its B side on p.2.
facts.sourceSentence: - 1 Player HP tracking card (double-sided: A side p.1, B side p.2)

facts.statement: There are eighteen distinct card faces in total.
facts.sourceSentence: - **18 distinct faces total.**

facts.statement: A card's cycle track is drawn as three squares descending the left edge followed by two more running right along the bottom.
facts.sourceSentence: three squares running DOWN the left edge, then two more running RIGHT along the bottom.

facts.statement: Cycle-track position 1 is always the yellow HP die slot, where a printed die shows the card's starting HP as pips.
facts.sourceSentence: Position 1 is always the **yellow HP die slot** (the die is printed there showing the card's starting HP as pips).

facts.statement: Cycle-track positions 2 through 5 contain icons, blanks, or dead spaces, and the die travels in the order 1 to 2 to 3 to 4 to 5.
facts.sourceSentence: Positions 2–5 hold icons, blanks, or dead spaces. Order of travel = 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.

facts.statement: Three kinds of cycle-track space exist.
facts.sourceSentence: Three kinds of space appear:

facts.statement: An icon space is a live space carrying an effect badge, joined to its neighbours by a yellow connector bar.
facts.sourceSentence: - **Icon space** — a live space with an effect badge. Connected to its neighbours by a YELLOW connector bar.

facts.statement: A blank space is a live plain dark-teal space with no icon, so no effect fires, and it is also yellow-connected.
facts.sourceSentence: - **Blank space** — a live space, plain dark-teal, no icon (no effect fires). Also YELLOW-connected.

facts.statement: A dead space is a darkened, diagonally hatched square connected by dull grey/teal bars rather than yellow ones.
facts.sourceSentence: - **Dead space** — a DARKENED, diagonally-HATCHED square. Connected by dull grey/teal bars, not yellow.

facts.statement: Landing on a dead space returns the die to position 1, per the rulebook.
facts.sourceSentence: Per the rulebook (`02-machine-phase.md`), landing on a dead space sends the die back to position 1.

facts.statement: The Player HP A-side card is the Player HP tracking card in normal mode.
facts.sourceSentence: - **Type:** Player HP tracking card (A side / normal mode)

facts.statement: The Player HP tracker has no starting HP of its own; the rules instead set the cube to 10.
facts.sourceSentence: - **Starting HP:** n/a (this is the tracker; rules set the cube to 10)

facts.statement: The Player HP A-side card prints the words PLAYER HP, A SIDE, SHIELD, 1X ROUND, and UTILITY.
facts.sourceSentence: - QUOTE — cards.pdf p.1, row 1 col 1: "PLAYER HP"

facts.statement: The Player HP track is a serpentine numbered track under a heart badge, running 10 down to 0 across 11 spaces.
facts.sourceSentence:
- **PLAYER HP track:** heart badge at top, then a serpentine numbered track: 10, 9 / 7, 8 / 6, 5 / 3, 4 / 2, 1 / 0.
(11 spaces, 10 down to 0.)

facts.statement: The A side's SHIELD section has four slots, drawn as four shield-with-plus badges in a 2x2 arrangement.
facts.sourceSentence: - **SHIELD section: 4 slots.** Four shield-with-"+" badges in a 2x2 arrangement.

facts.statement: The A side's UTILITY section, labelled "1X ROUND", has six slots in total.
facts.sourceSentence: - **UTILITY section (labelled "1X ROUND"): 6 slots total —**

facts.statement: Three of the A side's utility slots are "+/-" roll-modifier slots.
facts.sourceSentence: - **3 x "+/-" roll-modifier slots**

facts.statement: Three of the A side's utility slots are re-roll slots marked with a two-white-dice glyph.
facts.sourceSentence: - **3 x re-roll slots** (two-white-dice glyph)

facts.statement: The A side's utility slots are printed in three rows: two roll-modifiers, then a roll-modifier and a dice slot, then two dice slots.
facts.sourceSentence: - Printed layout: row 1 = [+/-] [+/-]; row 2 = [+/-] [dice]; row 3 = [dice] [dice].

facts.statement: The Player HP A-side card has no roll conditions, no cycle track, and no destroy effect.
facts.sourceSentence: - No roll conditions, no cycle track, no destroy effect.

facts.statement: The card at p.1 r1c2 is the Doom Machine tracking card and has no starting HP.
facts.sourceSentence:
- **Type:** Doom Machine tracking card
- **Starting HP:** n/a

facts.statement: The only words printed on the Doom Machine tracking card are THE, DOOM, MACHINE, SENTIENCE, and POWER.
facts.sourceSentence: - QUOTE — cards.pdf p.1, row 1 col 2: "THE"

facts.statement: The Sentience track on the Doom Machine card is numbered from 10 down to 0.
facts.sourceSentence: - QUOTE (Sentience track numerals, top to bottom): "10" "9" "7" "8" "6" "5" "3" "4" "2" "1" "0"

facts.statement: The Power track on the Doom Machine card is numbered from 10 down to 0.
facts.sourceSentence: - QUOTE (Power track numerals, top to bottom): "10" "9" "7" "8" "6" "5" "3" "4" "2" "1" "0"

facts.statement: The listed quotes are the complete printed content of the Doom Machine tracking card; it carries no other text.
facts.sourceSentence: - **That is the entire printed content of the card. There is no other text of any kind.**

facts.statement: The Doom Machine card's art shows a yellow eye badge for Sentience above the left track, a black battery badge for Power above the right track, the "THE DOOM MACHINE" logo plate between them, and two parallel serpentine 0–10 tracks.
facts.sourceSentence:
- Art: an eye badge (Sentience, yellow) above the left track, a battery badge (Power, black) above the right track,
the "THE DOOM MACHINE" logo plate between them. Two parallel serpentine 0–10 tracks.

facts.statement: The Doom Machine tracking card does not define what the Power and Sentience tracks do; it defines only their range of 0 through 10, with no threshold, trigger, win/loss condition, or per-turn effect printed.
facts.sourceSentence:
It defines only their RANGE (0 through 10). No threshold, no trigger, no win/loss condition, no per-turn effect
is printed anywhere on it.

facts.statement: Every card that reads the Power or Sentience tracks does so on the machine part cards rather than on the tracker.
facts.sourceSentence: cards, not on the tracker. Every card that reads the tracks is listed here:

facts.statement: Power and Sentience act as damage/severity multipliers consumed by specific cards, and no printed rule exists for what happens at the top of a track or for any track-based loss condition.
facts.sourceSentence:
So Power and Sentience are damage/severity multipliers consumed by specific cards. There is still NO printed
rule for what happens at the top of a track (10), and no track-based loss condition anywhere in the PDFs.
